description: Generate spoken audio from text using ElevenLabs voices via Runway. 49 voice presets available. Can also use custom voice IDs (eleven_multilingual_v2 only). MODELS: eleven_multilingual_v2 (default), eleven_v3 (expressive; supports audio tags like [laughs] and [whispers] in the text; preset voices only). COST: 1 credit per 50 characters. WORKFLOW: Returns task_id → poll or use wait_for_runway_task.

text.description: Text to speak. Max 1000 characters (5000 for eleven_v3, which also accepts audio tags like [laughs]).

voice.description: Voice preset name or custom voice UUID (custom voices require eleven_multilingual_v2). Default: Maya.

name: generate_speech
